scenarios.name: Actual sessions are isolated
scenarios.trigger: The same user starts session B after session A
scenarios.expected: Session B cannot read anchor A; no fallback to user/global

scenarios.name: User continuity across private and group chat
scenarios.trigger: The same authenticated platform user moves to a group
scenarios.expected: Same user partition; only evidence allowed for the current group audience reaches Prompt/output

scenarios.name: Other users remain distinct
scenarios.trigger: Another group member or a mismatched recall item uses the same anchor
scenarios.expected: Reject the mismatched resolved subject/anchor before reading or rendering

scenarios.name: Platform identity remains distinct
scenarios.trigger: Another platform repeats the same raw user ID
scenarios.expected: No identity merge without a verified mapping

scenarios.name: Global state is shared within the configured partition
scenarios.trigger: Two users/platforms access the same persona world partition
scenarios.expected: One logical public world state; source subjects, local occupancy and delivery targets remain distinct

scenarios.name: Sharing does not grant disclosure
scenarios.trigger: A private fact is requested through global or a group audience
scenarios.expected: Current audience/ACL rejects unauthorized content; global is not a privacy bypass

scenarios.name: Missing identity never widens scope
scenarios.trigger: A session/user request lacks a resolvable anchor or identity
scenarios.expected: Reject unresolved scope; do not default to a wider partition

scenarios.name: Policy changes fence old projections
scenarios.trigger: Sharing policy is changed while a request is in flight
scenarios.expected: Invalidate affected bindings/cursors/context caches; no silent historical data merge

scenarios.name: Retraction invalidates all dependent views
scenarios.trigger: Memory is corrected or retracted after user/global recall
scenarios.expected: Invalidate dependencies and recheck at output; do not replay external actions

scenarios.name: Shared state has bounded resource use
scenarios.trigger: Many sessions query one user/global partition
scenarios.expected: Paged reads and shared immutable data; aggregate bytes, inflight work and cache eviction are measured

scenarios.name: Platform migration preserves logical partitions
scenarios.trigger: Checkpoint is imported into another host
scenarios.expected: Reauthorize and rebind stable partition; keep raw source scope and actual delivery target

scenarios.name: Presets and data promotion are explicit
scenarios.trigger: Select session/user/global preset or promote an existing record
scenarios.expected: Policy chooses compatible domain partitions; migration/projection is explicit, never a key rename or replayed write
